features.feature: Produce one canonical English Markdown execution plan at docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md.
Enumerate exactly seven historical Finding failure classes and, for each, state the observed failure, why the current model permits it, and named retrievable evidence.

Derive point-in-time corpus figures through authorized CLI surfaces, include reproducible commands or a checked-in read-only procedure, and disclose HEAD/date, denominators, legacy evidenceState projection, optional-field gaps, and reviewer-run versus round semantics.
Label named incidents as historical observations and avoid claiming that an old outcome proves the same defect remains unresolved now.

Use characteristic evidence for all seven classes, including B-cdf6:F-056/F-067/F-070, B-META-framework-audit:F-029/F-030/F-031/F-032/F-035, repeated root-cause or runaway-review evidence, and current learning/signature audits.

Distinguish raw Finding provenance, derived learning/signature records, and current gate evidence; lineage dedup does not prove semantic defect equivalence and historical learning remains non-authoritative.
Define exactly four responsibility components: Finding Ledger Integrity; Candidate and Defect Identity; Dynamic Applicability; Freshness and Supersession.

Specify the end-to-end records and authority boundary from DetectorSignal through CandidateFinding, verified Finding, canonical defect, signed applicability assessment, routing, freshness, supersession, batch manifest, and Gate.
Keep detector hits, candidates, signature tags, playbooks, historical matches, file-disjoint heuristics, and DONE outcomes non-authoritative until current signed evidence is minted.

Define one shared blocking predicate: an open evidence- and severity-blocking Finding blocks only with a current signed applicable assessment, while missing, unknown, unsigned, stale, mismatched, or tampered high/critical assessments fail closed.
Require evidence-backed non-blocking verdicts: base/head and no worsening for pre-existing, structured scope proof plus routing for out-of-scope, and a valid canonical owner for duplicate.
Define freshness behavior for materialHash match, unrelated materialHash drift with matching storyFilesHash and explicit advisory, story-owned drift, scope drift, and runtime-artifact drift.

Preserve append-only history while resolving supersession chains and canonical records; keep legacy Findings readable, fail-safe when assessment is missing, and assess history lazily without bulk rewrite.
Define exactly three future implementation Stories: Dynamic Finding Applicability; Finding Identity and Historical Lineage; Finding Ledger and Runtime Evidence Integrity.
Map P1 through P7 to one primary component and exact future Story, distinguish direct solution from mitigation, and give each a falsifiable acceptance result.

Reconcile four components into three Stories, splitting historical supersession/canonical lookup into Story 2 and runtime receipt/stale-artifact invalidation into Story 3 without orphan responsibility.
Expose the acyclic safe execution order Story 3 then Story 2 then Story 1 enforcement; allow earlier Story 1 observe-only work only while non-gating.

Preserve the existing review-convergence breaker as a backstop, the review assurance floor, process-fact registry/contract-verifier duties, and merged-state combination review for parallel process-framework changes.

Require the three future Stories collectively to test concurrent write loss and retry idempotency, candidate-versus-Finding separation, canonical supersession, historical non-authority, base/head applicability and routing, stale scope/material/runtime invalidation, tamper rejection, and unknown high/critical fail-closed behavior.
Define observe, warn, and enforce rollout states with entry/exit criteria, permitted writes, authority, visible output, kill switch, rollback, and enforcement prerequisites.

Define a reproducible rollout scorecard with numerator, denominator, procedure, window, thresholds, and rollback triggers covering safety, classification, manual work/review cycles, and p50/p95 triage latency while separating compute, triage, genuine repair, and convergence costs.

Use @lattice/lab to @proof-or-stop/lab as a scope-change example: preserve B-cc10 historical out-of-scope, treat the new operator request as current scope evidence, remint a fresh assessment, and produce verified plus applicable without granting history gate authority.

Separate brand scope from package resolution; future rename acceptance must choose publish or local workspace/file-link policy and verify manifests, dependency, lockfiles, exact-name verifier, filesystem-path bootstrap distinction, and a clean temporary install.
Implement runtime schemas, commands, gates, receipts, locks, or package behavior in this specification Story.
